facts.fact: Revises F593: Ila reads the meaning of her grandfather's laid gloves as a payment-sign on the rock shelf above the Drum, after opening the queen's letter, not by a hut fire.
Revises F705: Sarala has kept the archive drawer since her crowning (thirty-one winters), not thirty.
Prince Udai came home alive from guiding Harish; the letter says only that Harish did not come home.
